calculation.description: Ranks assets by their 20-day cumulative return relative to the equal-weight cross-asset benchmark, scaled by 30-day residual volatility. The one-day lag prevents look-ahead.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2031-11-12 (data available through prior completed session)
validation.regime_notes: Positive full-history IC and ICIR clear the benchmark gates. Signal was positive in both up and down benchmark regimes, though regime ICIR was lower than full-history due to shorter subsamples; interpret conservatively given the 15-asset cross-section.
